headline: INS: Romanians Saved Energy in 2026 – Population's Consumption Fell by More Than 11%
summary: Romania's primary energy resources fell 6.3% in the first eight months of 2026, while electricity resources rose a modest 0.5%, according to provisional National Institute of Statistics data. Population consumption fell over 11%.
why: Energy consumption and supply trends shape demand for fuels and power and influence the outlook for Romania's economy and energy sector.
